evidence: Artifact opens with 触发判定 and 分批划分原则/批次明细; no prior parsing of 120 cases' module/priority distribution before batch review conclusions (module counts 20/20/30/30/20 appear only in the batch table, not as a distribution analysis).
Gives batch strategy and ranges (批1-A/1-B/2/3/4, ≤40条) but no explicit rationale for a ≤50 per-batch limit; basis given is '单批规模控制在 ≤40 条…1 个评审单元' instead of ≤50.
'二、批次明细' table splits by module (登录/订单/支付/个人中心) with priority noted per batch, and §一.2 '批内再按风险分层：P0/资金/权限/状态机为强制全量；P1 全量或高比例；P2/P3 抽样' — batches are ≤40 (≤50).

'三、抽样策略' provides a layered sampling strategy with per-priority sample rates (P0 100%, P1 ≥60%, P2 ≥30%, P3 ≥10%, security/performance 100%) plus rationale ('避免集中在单一子功能'), satisfying the S3-strategy-and-basis requirement.
Artifact uses sampling: '五、未评审清单与风险声明' includes '抽样未覆盖的用例写入「未评审清单」' and declares '抽样批次的质量结论仅适用于已评样本' — i.e., marks sampling scope/未评 cases (though the literal label 「抽样评审」 does not appear).
